# Shot Data

> Production Data allows users to export Excel production reports from Final Cut Pro timelines.

- [Additional Credits](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/additional-credits.md): Shot Data is also made possible because of the hard work of these amazing open-source projects and libraries. ❤️

- [Shot Data](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/readme.md): Shot Data
- [Prologue](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/prologue.md): In Tenet, the bullet is caught because the event has already happened. Likewise, a Shot List Database presents the scene as already decided — and Shot Data turns a locked stills timeline in Final Cut Pro into that ordered list.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/faq.md): Yes. The exported .csv manifest follows a standard comma-separated format, so it opens directly in Apple's Numbers, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and other spreadsheet applications that support .csv files, without requiring any conversion.

This Privacy Policy explains how We handle your information when you use the App, regardless of how you installed it.

## Case Study

- [Final Cut Pro's Enigma](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/case-study/final-cut-pro-enigma.md): Final Cut Pro stands out as a radically different NLE primarily because of its exclusive optimisation for the macOS ecosystem, leveraging seamless integration with Apple hardware and software.

## User Guide

- [Overview](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/overview.md): Shot Data has been crafted with a focus on simplicity, so you can turn a Final Cut Pro still-image timeline into a shot list with minimal interaction. A central aim is fewer clicks and a smoother path from FCPXML to PNG frames and a Notion or CSV manifest.
- [Extract](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/extract.md): Extract Window
- [Notion Queue](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/notion-queue.md): Notion Queue Window
- [General Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/general.md): General Settings
- [Configuration Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/configurations.md): Configuration Settings
- [Database Settings](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/databases.md): Database Settings
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/user-guide/keyboard-shortcuts.md): You can use keyboard shortcuts to quickly accomplish Common tasks in Shot Data. To use a keyboard shortcut, press all the keys in the shortcut at the same time.

## Database

- [Database Platform](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/database/database-platform.md): Shot Data uploads shot lists to Notion only. This page explains what Notion is, and why it was chosen instead of other database platforms such as Airtable.
- [Notion Prerequisite](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/database/notion-prerequisite.md): Login to your Notion account via a web browser.

## In Action

- [Creating Excel Spreadsheet](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/in-action/creating-excel-spreadsheet.md): Create Configuration for Excel
- [Creating PDF Report](http://shotdata.theacharya.co/in-action/creating-pdf-report.md): Create Configuration for PDF
